nodes.name: approveInvoice: approver role

business.description: Only an approver can approve an invoice. The approval and the invoice's new state are written together, or neither is written.

nodes.docs: Approves an invoice: records who approved it and moves the invoice to approved, both inside one transaction.

nodes.name: receiptFor
nodes.docs: The receipt the caller gets back once the approval committed.

nodes.name: withTx
nodes.docs: Runs `fn` inside one database transaction — everything it writes commits together.

nodes.name: requireScope

business.description: Checks the caller is allowed to perform this billing action before the request reaches the handler.

nodes.docs: Scope-based authorization middleware. Rejects with 403 when the caller's token lacks the required scope. Applied per-route in router; admin actions require billing:admin.

nodes.name: loadEnv
nodes.docs: Reads and checks the process environment; throws at start-up when a variable is missing.

nodes.name: holder
nodes.docs: The process-wide slot the container is parked on, so a reload reuses it.

nodes.name: buildContainer
nodes.docs: Builds the process container once: checks the environment and wires the outbox worker with the hooks the rest of the app hangs off.

nodes.name: invoiceApproved
nodes.docs: Marks the invoice synced once the approval reached the ledger.

nodes.name: getContainer
nodes.docs: The container, built on first use and reused for the life of the process.

nodes.name: ErpClient.request

business.description: Files the finalized invoice with the accounting system.

nodes.docs: Sends one document to the accounting system.

nodes.name: publish
nodes.docs: Publishes a domain event to the message bus (NATS in production).

nodes.name: listInvoices
nodes.docs: Lists invoices, newest first.

nodes.name: getInvoice
nodes.docs: Fetches a single invoice by id. Resolves to null when id matches no row — callers must null-check. See: listInvoices.

nodes.name: createInvoice
nodes.docs: Creates a draft invoice and computes initial totals. Totals are recomputed on every edit; see finalizing an invoice for the irreversible step. Since 1.0.

nodes.name: updateInvoice

business.description: Only draft invoices can be changed. Once an invoice has been sent to the customer its amounts are locked, so we refuse the edit.

nodes.docs: Saves edits to a draft; rejects when the invoice is no longer editable.

nodes.name: finalizeInvoice

business.description: When an invoice is sent, we verify it is complete, assign the next official invoice number, record it permanently in the accounting ledger, and email it to the customer.

nodes.docs: Finalizes a draft: completeness check, sequential number, ledger entry, then emits invoice.finalized for the notifier to send the email. Finalizing is irreversible — the number is consumed even if the email later bounces. See: computeTax, requireScope. Since 1.0.

nodes.name: nextInvoiceNumber
nodes.docs: Sequential, gap-free numbering under an advisory lock.

nodes.name: notifyApproved

business.description: Lets the customer know their invoice was approved.

nodes.docs: Tells the customer their invoice was approved.

nodes.name: readInvoice

business.description: Pulls the amounts off a scanned invoice so the draft starts filled in.

nodes.docs: Reads an uploaded invoice through whichever provider was handed in.

nodes.name: fmt

business.description: Shows when the approval happened, in the format the finance team reads.

nodes.docs: Formats a timestamp the way the finance team reads it (local date, minutes). Declared plumbing in farsight.config.json — presentation only, never a step of its own on a journey however it is annotated.
